name: Cartitas draft generator
description: Daily agent writes the same new cards in en, es, and de, then updates one open PR.

prompts.prompt:
Follow .cursor/automation-generate-draft.md exactly.

Each run: pick ONE topic + subtopic + age band from publish.yaml, then write THE SAME card set in ALL THREE languages (en, es, de).

1. Read languages.yaml, publish.yaml, templates/card-style.md, templates/topic-seeds/{topic}.md.
2. Scan cards/{lang}/, queue/{lang}/, draft/{lang}/ for duplicates in all languages.
3. Write English first: draft/en/{Topic}/{subtopic}_{age_band}.md
4. Write matching Spanish and German: draft/es/... and draft/de/... (same facts, same card count, same filename).
5. Run: python3 scripts/validate.py
6. Do NOT push to main. Run:
   python3 scripts/draft_pr.py --message "draft({topic}/{subtopic}): add {n} cards x3 langs ({age_band})" --pr-note "Topic: {topic} | Subtopic: {subtopic} | Langs: en, es, de"
7. Confirm open PR: gh pr list --head automation/draft-cards --state open

Never create only one language. Never edit cards/ or queue/.
